replacements.Sesgos y regulación en sistemas multimod: Bias and regulation in multimodal systems
replacements.Los sesgos demográficos codificados en l: Demographic biases encoded in training data are amplified during alignment and remain invisible to generic benchmarks. The EU AI Act classifies systems by risk and requires specific safeguards for systems that affect people.
replacements.Las imágenes de internet no representan: Internet images do not represent demographics, geographies, or cultural contexts equitably. The model learns the distributions in the data, not those of the real world.
replacements.El alineamiento con preferencias humanas: Alignment with human preferences can amplify pretraining biases instead of correcting them if annotators share the same cultural biases.
replacements.Los benchmarks genéricos no lo detectan: Generic benchmarks do not detect it
replacements.Un benchmark de capacidad general puede: A general-capability benchmark can give a high score even when the model fails systematically on underrepresented groups. The bias becomes visible only in subgroup-specific benchmarks.
replacements.tasas de error sistemáticamente más alta: systematically higher error rates for people with darker skin and for women
replacements.análisis de CV con foto o vídeo puede pe: CV analysis using photos or video can penalize physical traits unrelated to the role
replacements.diagnóstico por imagen con representació: image-based diagnosis with unequal representation of groups in the training data
replacements.chatbots genéricos, filtros de spam, rec: generic chatbots, spam filters, content recommendations
replacements.sistemas que interactúan con personas (c: systems that interact with people (voice chatbots, disclosed deepfakes)
replacements.Obligación de transparencia: el usuario: Transparency obligation: the user must know they are interacting with AI
replacements.reconocimiento facial, selección de pers: facial recognition, personnel selection, medical diagnosis, critical infrastructure
replacements.Registro de actividad · evaluación de im: Activity logging · impact assessment · mandatory human oversight · bias auditing
replacements.puntuación social, vigilancia biométrica: social scoring, mass real-time biometric surveillance in public spaces
replacements.Prohibido en la UE sin excepción: Prohibited in the EU without exception
replacements.Los sistemas multimodales que procesan i: Multimodal systems that process images, video, or audio of people in personnel-selection, medical-evaluation, or access-control contexts fall into the high-risk category. It is not enough for the system to work well on average: the regulation requires auditable results and a human in the decision loop when decisions have consequences for people.
